data.text: [00:05]It was a few months ago … I was really nervous … really scared. `[00:11]It was for a good promotion and I wanted it so much! `[00:16]I decided to use a kind of meditation – and I repeated positive things to myself to try and stay focused and to control my fear. `[00:26]I think it worked … because the interview went well and I got the job!

[00:34]My brother had a serious illness last year … he had problems with his heart. `[00:40]He’s much better now, thankfully, but because of his illness, I decided to do something positive, something to help … I ran one marathon every day for a week to raise money. `[00:53]It was a huge challenge – really difficult … but I did it … and I raised nearly two thousand pounds for charity.

[01:04]Next year, I’m going to South America with a friend of mine. `[01:09]We want to see the world a bit before we go to university. `[01:14]I’m going to have Spanish lessons and try to learn as much as I can before we go. `[01:21]The thing is that my friend speaks very good Spanish, but I don’t speak any … and I don’t want to rely on her all the time.

[01:35]When you go on a long trek somewhere … like the Arctic – where it’s very cold, or across a desert – where it’s very hot … it’s obviously hard to survive. `[01:46]You know, … you need a lot of physical strength. `[01:50]You also need a lot of mental strength – you need to be prepared to face difficult things without giving up.

[02:01]I’ve wanted to be a doctor since I was really young … for as long as I can remember, really. `[02:07]I know that you have to study for years and years, and do very long hours, all through the night sometimes. `[02:14.5]But I am definitely prepared to do the hard work. `[02:18.5]I’m determined to achieve my goal and be a doctor.
